_README: Tile-usage presets: named subsets of furniture_catalog.json that say 'these are the tiles an LLM should use when furnishing/parsing the tilemap'. Created/edited in catalog_web.py and consumed by tile_presets.py (--menu prints the LLM-facing tile menu). 'active' names the default preset the LLM uses. Each preset: {description, tiles:[catalog names], notes:{name: hint}}.

general-library.description: General interior furnishing palette: reading rooms / book stacks / study desks (library) AND lounges, cafes, studios, galleries (a student commons like Meyerson). Restored 45-tile library palette + cafe food, a clockwork floor lamp, and moon paintings.

notes.counter: cafe service counter; line along a wall, set food/mugs on top
notes.round_table_small: cafe / lounge bistro table; ring stools or chairs around it
notes.clockwork_lamp_floor: ornate floor lamp; cafe corner or beside the counter
notes.painting_moon: framed moon painting; hang on a gallery wall
notes.painting_moon_light: illuminated moon painting; gallery focal piece
notes.cabinet_display: glass display case for the gallery
